clues.text: When Jesus fed five thousand, a boy offered five loaves made from it, along with two small fish.
At the threshing floor, Boaz poured six measures of this grain into Ruth's shawl before she went home.
Naomi and Ruth came back from Moab to Bethlehem just as the harvest of this grain began.
Near Gideon's camp, a Midianite dreamed a loaf of this bread tumbled in and knocked a tent flat.
When hail struck Egypt, this crop was ripe and was destroyed, but the later wheat was spared.
Absalom had his servants set fire to Joab's field of this grain so Joab would come see him.
During the famine in Samaria, Elisha foretold that two seahs of it would sell for a shekel at the gate.
